days.title: Interview method, core C#, React, and high-yield DSA
days.focus: Prepare concise experience stories, refresh everyday C# and React fundamentals, and practice the coding patterns that appear most often.

days.title: .NET and ASP.NET Core application development
days.focus: Review the runtime, language details, async and memory, request pipeline, dependency injection, APIs, identity, and production behavior most likely to come up in a senior .NET interview.

days.title: SQL, EF Core, security, and data access
days.focus: Cover relational modeling, query behavior, indexing, transactions, EF Core tradeoffs, and the web security fundamentals expected of a full-stack engineer.

days.title: JavaScript, TypeScript, and browser foundations
days.focus: Refresh the language and browser behavior needed to reason about React code, async work, data, modules, types, and network requests.

days.title: Remaining React and frontend engineering
days.focus: Review component behavior, state, effects, rendering, performance, accessibility, browser storage, routing, testing, and deployment.

days.title: Architecture, distributed systems, and system design
days.focus: Practice translating requirements into components and tradeoffs, then explain reliability, data flow, consistency, messaging, scaling, and observability.

days.title: Delivery, testing, operations, and remaining DSA breadth
days.focus: Finish the full topic sweep with deployment and operations, quality practices, and less frequent but useful algorithmic techniques.
